messages:
maya: quick note - v2-ptq canary shows funcall parse fails for some structured outputs; parser sees stray backslash before quotes.
jon: example from logs: ``{"tool":"get_user","args":"{\"id\":\"u_9\"}\"}`` parser throws.
ali: likely PTQ changed token boundaries; small tail but causes retries and duplicate calls.
maya: short-term: add sanitizer that strips control chars and collapses repeated backslashes before parsing. opt-in toggle for canary.
jon: + add idempotency check in dispatcher to drop exact-duplicate tool invocations within single response.
ci-bot: queued job `ptq-sanitize-smoke` against canary set - ETA 20m.
ops-bot: alert: 1 duplicate tool call seen for customer: delta-labs; tagging eng-ml.
ali: long-term: add token-boundary parity tests in PTQ CI and fail builds that raise parse-error rate > 0.1%.
maya: will open PR for sanitizer + toggle + logging. will sample original vs sanitized diffs to S3.
jon: once PR up ping #eng-infra for a quick canary deploy.
ci-bot: `ptq-sanitize-smoke` passed (sha: a1b2c3) - detailed report in S3.
ops-bot: incident mitigated on canary after sanitizer sampling enabled.
